# Amazon Marketplace — Canonical Card Pack v16 Edge Taxonomy Ready

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: amazon.v16.closed_edge_taxonomy
  status: resolved
  resolution: Added closed-taxonomy traversal edges for metric dependencies, reconciliation units, mismatch categories,
    reconciliation variants, and output contracts.
- issue_id: amazon.v16.claim_surface_alignment
  status: resolved
  resolution: Aligned amount semantics, embeddings, and role boundaries for revenue, tax, and settlement product-sales
    fields.
```

## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

Reusable Amazon marketplace semantic pack. Client runtime cards and account bindings are out of scope.

## 2. Validation Contract

This pack targets locked full-spectrum validation with universal semantic profiles and closed canonical edge taxonomy.

    - expression: fp.zen_status = true
      filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
      required: true
    - expression: fp.is_duplicated = false
      filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
      required: true
    - expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
      filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
      required: false
    group_by_options:
    - sku
    time_basis: created_date or settlement_date depending on source table
    join_requirements:
    - relationship_id: relationship.amazon.fee_preview_to_disbursment.sku
      left_table: table.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview
      right_cte: actual_fees
      join_type: inner
      condition: fp.sku = af.sku_id
      grain_safety: aggregate disbursement ItemFees to SKU before joining
    aggregation_rules:
    - Aggregate actual disbursement ItemFees by SKU before joining to fee preview.
    output_contract_id: output_contract.amazon.fee_variance
    sql_pattern_ref: sql.amazon.fee_preview.expected_vs_actual
    scope_policy: runtime filters may be applied externally; do not hardcode group_level_id in canonical pattern
    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: athena_trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: sku
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only
      runtime_parameters:
      - name: group_level_id
        type: integer
        required: false
        source: runtime_account_data_binding
      - name: start_date
        type: date
        required: false
        source: runtime_user_or_workflow_parameter
      - name: end_date
        type: date
        required: false
        source: runtime_user_or_workflow_parameter
      required_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview
      - table.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment
      required_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.sku
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.gross_commission
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.is_active
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.zen_status
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.is_duplicated
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.sku_id
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.mp_fee_type
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.transaction_type
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.charged_amount
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.is_active
      ctes:
      - actual_fees
      joins:
      - relationship_id: relationship.amazon.fee_preview_to_disbursment.sku
        left_table: table.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview
        right_cte: actual_fees
        join_type: inner
        condition: fp.sku = af.sku_id
        grain_safety: aggregate disbursement ItemFees to SKU before joining
      template: "WITH actual_fees AS (\n  SELECT\n    sku_id,\n    SUM(CASE\n      WHEN mp_fee_type = 'ItemFees'\
        \ AND transaction_type = 'Order'\n      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0\n    END) AS actual_item_fees\n  FROM\
        \ zs_observe.amazon_disbursment d\n  WHERE d.is_active = true\n    /* optional runtime scope: AND d.group_level_id\
        \ = :group_level_id */\n  GROUP BY sku_id\n)\nSELECT\n  fp.sku,\n  fp.gross_commission AS expected_fee,\n\
        \  af.actual_item_fees AS actual_fee,\n  fp.gross_commission + af.actual_item_fees AS fee_variance\nFROM\
        \ zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview fp\nJOIN actual_fees af\n  ON fp.sku = af.sku_id\nWHERE fp.is_active = true\n\
        \  AND fp.zen_status = true\n  AND fp.is_duplicated = false\nORDER BY ABS(fp.gross_commission + af.actual_item_fees)\
        \ DESC"
      filters:
      - expression: d.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
      - expression: fp.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
      - expression: fp.zen_status = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
      - expression: fp.is_duplicated = false
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
      - expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: false
      group_by:
      - sku_id in actual_fees
      order_by:
      - ABS(fee_variance) DESC
      output_columns:
      - name: sku
        source: column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.sku
      - name: expected_fee
        source: column.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview.gross_commission
      - name: actual_fee
        source: expression:SUM_disbursement_ItemFees_Order_charged_amount
      - name: fee_variance
        source: metric.marketplace.actual_fee_variance
      safety_rules:
      - Runtime tenant or group scope must be injected from account_data_binding; reusable Amazon marketplace cards
        must not hardcode group_level_id values.
      - Preserve documented mandatory quality filters before applying metric logic.
      operation_shape: trend_or_grouped_aggregate
      date_basis: not_date_grouped
      scope_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.group_level_id
      filter_plan:
      - stage: base_where
        expression: d.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
        source: source document rule
      - stage: base_where
        expression: fp.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
        source: source document rule
      - stage: base_where
        expression: fp.zen_status = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
        source: source document rule
      - stage: base_where
        expression: fp.is_duplicated = false
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
        source: source document rule
      - stage: runtime_injection
        expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: false
        source: runtime parameter
      join_plan:
      - relationship_id: relationship.amazon.fee_preview_to_disbursment.sku
        join_type: inner
        left: table.zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview
        right: actual_fees
        condition: fp.sku = af.sku_id
        join_keys:
        - left_expression: fp.sku
          right_expression: af.sku_id
          normalization: exact_match
        grain_safety: aggregate disbursement ItemFees to SKU before joining
      pre_aggregation:
      - cte: actual_fees
        source_table: table.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment
        group_by:
        - sku_id
        purpose: Aggregate actual ItemFees to SKU before joining one-row-per-SKU fee preview.
      normalization:
        join_key_normalization: exact_match_unless_source_specific_rule_overrides
        amount_sign_policy: preserve signed source amounts; use ABS only where the documented formula requires it
        concat_keys: []
      concat_keys: []
      grain_assertion:
        declared_grain: sku
        group_by:
        - sku_id in actual_fees
        one_row_per: sku
      output_contract_id: output_contract.amazon.fee_variance

    sql_pattern_ref: sql.amazon.fee_preview.volumetric_gap
    scope_policy: runtime filters may be applied externally; do not hardcode group_level_id in canonical pattern
    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: athena_trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: sku

      runtime_parameters:

        required: true

        filter_type: business_filter
        required: true
      - expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: false

    - expression: d.is_active = true

    sql_pattern_ref: sql.amazon.disbursement.return_loss

    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: athena_trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: sku

      required_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.amazon_oms
      - table.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment
      required_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_oms.order_id
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_oms.sku_id
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_oms.transaction_type
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_oms.is_active
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.order_id
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.mp_fee_type
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.charged_amount_type
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.transaction_type
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.charged_amount
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.is_active
      ctes:
      - return_orders
      - fee_components
      joins:
      - relationship_id: relationship.amazon.oms_to_disbursment.order_id
        left_cte: return_orders
        right_cte: fee_components
        join_type: left
        condition: ro.order_id = fc.order_id
        grain_safety: summarize disbursement to order before joining return order rows
      template: "WITH return_orders AS (\n  SELECT DISTINCT\n    order_id,\n    sku_id\n  FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms\
        \ o\n  WHERE o.is_active = true\n    AND o.transaction_type = 'reverse'\n    /* optional runtime scope:\
        \ AND o.group_level_id = :group_level_id */\n),\nfee_components AS (\n  SELECT\n    order_id,\n    SUM(CASE\n\
        \      WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund'\n       AND mp_fee_type = 'ItemPrice'\n       AND charged_amount_type\
        \ = 'principal'\n      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0\n    END) AS refunded_principal,\n    SUM(CASE\n\
        \      WHEN transaction_type = 'Order'\n       AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee', 'tech fee', 'pickup\
        \ fee')\n      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0\n    END) AS operational_fees_charged,\n    SUM(CASE\n  \
        \    WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund'\n       AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee',\
        \ 'tech fee', 'pickup fee')\n      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0\n    END) AS operational_fees_recovered,\n\
        \    SUM(CASE\n      WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'commission'\n      THEN\
        \ ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0\n    END) AS commission_charged,\n    SUM(CASE\n      WHEN transaction_type\
        \ = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'refund commission'\n      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0\n    END) AS\
        \ commission_recovered\n  FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment d\n  WHERE d.is_active = true\n    /* optional\
        \ runtime scope: AND d.group_level_id = :group_level_id */\n  GROUP BY order_id\n)\nSELECT\n  ro.sku_id,\n\
        \  COUNT(DISTINCT ro.order_id) AS return_orders,\n  SUM(fc.refunded_principal) AS refunded_principal,\n\
        \  SUM(GREATEST(fc.operational_fees_charged - fc.operational_fees_recovered, 0)) AS unrecovered_operational_fees,\n\
        \  SUM(GREATEST(fc.commission_charged - fc.commission_recovered, 0)) AS unrecovered_commission,\n  SUM(\n\
        \    fc.refunded_principal\n    + GREATEST(fc.operational_fees_charged - fc.operational_fees_recovered,\
        \ 0)\n    + GREATEST(fc.commission_charged - fc.commission_recovered, 0)\n  ) AS estimated_return_loss\n\
        FROM return_orders ro\nLEFT JOIN fee_components fc\n  ON ro.order_id = fc.order_id\nGROUP BY ro.sku_id\n\
        ORDER BY estimated_return_loss DESC"
      filters:
      - expression: o.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
      - expression: d.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true
      - expression: o.transaction_type = 'reverse'
        filter_type: business_filter
        required: true
      - expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: false
      group_by:
      - ro.sku_id
      order_by:
      - estimated_return_loss DESC
      output_columns:
      - name: sku_id
        source: column.zs_observe.amazon_oms.sku_id
      - name: return_orders
        source: expression:COUNT_DISTINCT_return_order_id
      - name: refunded_principal
        source: expression:refund_principal_sum
      - name: unrecovered_operational_fees
        source: expression:shipping_tech_pickup_fee_loss
      - name: unrecovered_commission
        source: expression:commission_loss_after_refund_commission
      - name: estimated_return_loss
        source: metric.marketplace.return_loss

      - Preserve documented mandatory quality filters before applying metric logic.

      date_basis: not_date_grouped
      scope_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_oms.group_level_id
      - column.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment.group_level_id
      filter_plan:
      - stage: base_where
        expression: o.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter

        expression: d.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        required: true

      - stage: base_where
        expression: o.transaction_type = 'reverse'
        filter_type: business_filter
        required: true
        source: source document rule
      - stage: runtime_injection
        expression: group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter
        required: false
        source: runtime parameter
      join_plan:
      - relationship_id: relationship.amazon.oms_to_disbursment.order_id
        join_type: left
        left: return_orders
        right: fee_components
        condition: ro.order_id = fc.order_id
        join_keys:
        - left_expression: ro.order_id
          right_expression: fc.order_id
          normalization: exact_match
        grain_safety: summarize disbursement to order before joining return order rows
      pre_aggregation:
      - cte: fee_components
        source_table: table.zs_observe.amazon_disbursment

        purpose: Aggregate disbursement price and fee components to order grain before joining OMS return orders.

        source_table: table.zs_observe.amazon_oms
        group_by:
        - order_id

      normalization:
        join_key_normalization: exact_match_unless_source_specific_rule_overrides
        amount_sign_policy: preserve signed source amounts; use ABS only where the documented formula requires it
        concat_keys: []
      concat_keys: []

      execution_status: template_ready
